scope_notes: Only public commands and SDK geometry outputs were inspected in an empty owned Rhino document, at idle outside RunPythonScript Undo, on private Xvfb.

Thirty-six recipes cover WorldCoordinates toggles and per-command reset, rotated and tilted CPlanes, remembered Rigid including cancellation, and axis defaults retained from the last complete XYZ set rather than partial canceled factors.

Rigid translates tight bounding-box centers while preserving source geometry. Nine source kinds, asymmetric rational tight versus control bounds, group centers, overlapping top memberships, unit order, both Copy choices and repeated copies are captured.

Complete geometry definitions, weights, knots, domains, meshes, object order, group membership, selection, public displayed grip positions and external Undo/Redo are replayed through full and incremental application input, with absolute epsilon 1e-9.

Rigid Copy ignores selected grip owners even when parents are selected. Captured numeric NoCopy workflows leave public CurrentLocation positions under the partial XY map with Z factor 1, without replacing owner geometry or recording an edit. Three follow-up Move captures independently show original controls used by the next command and reset display on Undo/Redo; each replays through both input paths.
Rust previews reuse source display geometry with cached group centers and per-object translations. Four-view scene and clipping regressions are verified; no native preview image match is claimed.

SubCrv, live Rigid grip picking, all trimmed or singular representations, cross-viewport changes, general calculator expressions, scripted cursor dependencies, performance and full native parity remain unproven.
